answer.location_description: Bottom-left corner of the image, roughly rows 19-23 and columns 0-3. This is the background or lung periphery, away from the centred nodule.
answer.mechanism: There are two opposing families of structured first-layer units. Family A (units 3, 5, 14, 15, 19, 21, 23, 24, 26, 28) has large positive biases and a centre-weighted template. Propagated through W2 and W3 it lowers the logit; unit 26's net effect is about -1.5e4 in integer units, pushing toward benign. Family B (units 0, 11, 16, 18, 20, 27, 30) has negative biases and roughly the inverse template. It raises the logit; unit 27's net effect is about +2e4, pushing toward malignant. In the bottom-left corner, family A units carry consistent strong negative weights and family B units carry consistent strong positive weights. Bright pixels there therefore switch off the benign-voting units and switch on the malignant-voting units. Both pathways raise the malignant logit.
answer.evidence: Family A, bottom-left block: unit 3 r19-20 c0-2 = -52 -23 -34 / -54 -64 -32. Unit 5 r19-20 c0-3 = -17 -57 -31 -35 / -45 -56 -55 -31. Unit 15 r19-22 c0-3 are mostly -30 to -52. Unit 28 r19 c0-2 = -47 -40 -54. Units 21, 26, 19, 24 and 23 show similar negatives. These blocks average about -25 to -33 per weight, roughly twice the other corners; the top-left and bottom-right corners are near zero or positive in these units. Family B, same block: unit 27 r19-21 c0-3 = 8 39 52 46 / 48 26 57 24 / 21 9 39 49. Unit 11 r19 c0-2 = 43 63 67. Unit 30 r21 c0-2 = 39 22 51. Unit 16 r18-19 c0 = 48, 47. The pattern repeats across about 17 units in a fixed asymmetric location. Real anatomy should not favour one corner, because nodule crops have arbitrary placement. The top-right corner shows a weaker version of the same signature, so a secondary or diagonal artifact cannot be ruled out. The noise-like units (1, 2, 4, 6-10, 12, 13, 17, 22, 25, 29, 31) show no structure.
answer.main_feature: The model mainly compares a centre-and-margin template of the nodule (bright, compact central blob versus the surrounding ring and texture, centred around rows 8-17 and columns 6-19). Units responding to a compact, well-defined central pattern vote benign. The inverse-template units vote malignant, responding to irregular or extended margins and surrounding density.
